Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

1. Scope — Dimensional and other requirements for ankle bolt for SACH foot. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1 or 2. 

2.1 A deviation of ± 2.5 percent shall be permitted on all dimensions. 

3. Material 

3.1 Screw and Nut — The material for bolt and nut shall be in accordance with IS : 1363-1967 
'Specification for black hexagon bolts, nuts and locknuts (diameter 6 to 39 mm) and black hexagon 
screws (diameter 6 to 24 mm) ( first revision )'. 

3.2 Plain and Locking Washer — Low carbon steel. 

3.3 Spring Washer — Steel conforming to IS : 4072-1975 'Specification for steel for spring washers 
( first revision )'. 

4. Workmanship and Finish — The components shall be free from cracks, burrs, pits and other 
defects. There shall be no sharp edges on any component. The threads shall be cleanly cut. 

5. Marking — Each bolt shall be marked with the manufacturers name, initial or recognized 
trade-mark. 

5.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with Indian Standards Institution. 

6. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the manufacturer.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

In this revision an alternate design for SACH foot has been included. This design is considered 
to be an improvement over the existing design. 

This edition 1.2 incorporates Amendment No. 1 (November 1985) and Amendment No. 2 
(November 1986). Side bar indicates modification of the text as the result of incorporation of the 
amendments.
